translucency.note: sorts: vanilla's own (MeshData.SortState.buildSortedIndexBuffer) while measuring, on vanilla's worker threads unless counted as render thread (vanilla's synchronous builds of nearby sections); Quicksilver takes each new index list and uploads only that list at the end of the frame, where vanilla uploads its own

uploadBudget.note: Quicksilver's terrain uploads at the end of each measured frame: bytes copied into its arenas, meshes put in (those of the camera's section and its neighbours are never held back), sections still waiting for a later frame

visibility.sections: vanilla's frustum and cave graph (SectionOcclusionGraph), unchanged

backFaces.note: Quicksilver's terrain triangles per frame (solid and cutout after leaving out facing groups that face away from the camera, plus translucent whole); trianglesAllFacesPerFrame is the same frames with every layer drawn whole, as before package 4b

gui.note: the game's GUI pass (GuiRenderer): draw calls of its draw pass and of its preparation (item atlas, picture-in-picture); states = distinct pipeline/texture/scissor per part of the pass (fewest possible draws); reordered = draws if each element joined the latest earlier draw of its state with nothing overlapping it in between (text glyphs, which carry no bounds, counted as overlapping everything; IgnoringText: as overlapping nothing, an upper bound on what reordering could win); pipelines, texture setups, scissor areas = distinct ones per part of the pass (what makes the states differ); draws also count the menu blur's own draws, which the game runs inside its GUI draw pass (not listed)

mesher.biomeTints: vanilla's blend, biomes kept per section

meshing.note: sections meshed while measuring (sections, compileMs*, msPerSection) and over the whole bench (bench*), with the mesher named: quicksilver's own (package 4c; its time plus the copy into the staged buffer) or vanilla's SectionCompiler with Quicksilver's Fabric Renderer API implementation plus the transcode into the 16-byte vertex (mesher off)
